theme_strategy: Dark Theme Default. High-Contrast 'Swiss Brutalist' meets 'Luxury B2B'. Core colors: Black, Yellow, White. Deep void black backgrounds, pure white text for readability, and vibrant warning/electric yellow for CTA and data highlights.

typography.numbers_and_data: JetBrains Mono - Crucial for financial tables, IDs, and admin fees.

visual_enhancers.cards: Flat solid surfaces with 1px border-[#222222]. No soft shadows. Sharp edges or max 4px radius.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for sticky headers or dropdowns. bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl and border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Hover states should lift elements slightly (-translate-y-1) and change border to Yellow/White with high contrast.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include subtle noise or grain on the login hero background to avoid digital flatness.

component_name.buttons: Shadcn Button: Overridden to be sharp (rounded-none or rounded-sm), primary is Yellow with Black text, hover makes it slightly lighter yellow.
component_name.tables: Shadcn Table: Dense padding, tabular-nums for financial data. Use pure white for values, muted grey for headers.
component_name.inputs: Shadcn Input: bg-[#0F0F11] border-[#222222] focus:border-yellow-400 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-yellow-400.
component_name.charts: Recharts or Shadcn Charts. Line/Bar charts using Yellow as the primary data line, white for secondary.

grids.dashboard: Mode B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6.
grids.widgets: Use col-span-3 for summary cards, col-span-9 for main chart, col-span-12 for data tables.

layouts.admin_dashboard: Fixed Left Sidebar (w-64, border-r border-[#222222]) + Main Content Area. Top header for user profile and quick actions.
layouts.spacing: Generous internal padding for cards (p-6 or p-8). Gap between major sections: gap-12.

motion.transitions: Specific transitions only. transition-transform duration-200 ease-out for buttons. Do not use transition-all.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for dashboard widgets on load.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #0F0F11 meets WCAG AAA. Yellow on Black meets AAA. Avoid low contrast grey text for critical financial data.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FFD700] focus:outline-none.

media.icons: lucide-react (Standard) or install @phosphor-icons/react for duotone/high-end technical look.
media.images_usage: Use the provided vinyl/abstract images for the Login page background with a bg-black/50 overlay to ensure login form readability.

3d_libraries.charts: Recharts for financial data (Admin dashboard totals, revenue). Use clear, sharp tooltips with tabular numbers.

image_urls.description: Abstract yellow light tracing a vinyl record. Represents music and the brand's yellow color.
Smooth golden surface. Good for premium empty states or report covers.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a B2B SaaS for Acorde (music rights administration). Do NOT make it look like a generic SaaS template.
Wipe existing standard Tailwind configuration colors and enforce the Black, Yellow (#FFD700), White palette in tailwind.config.js.
Dashboard must feel dense, precise, and financial. Use tabular-nums (JetBrains Mono) for all currency and percentage values (Admin fees).
Never use space grotesk, inter, or roboto for headings. Use Outfit.
Do not center-align tabular data; align currency/numbers to the right, and text to the left.
Forms for uploading Abramus files should have a dashed border dropzone with a Yellow hover state.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn Select and Calendar components.
Since files are .js/.jsx, avoid TypeScript specific syntax and use standard React PropTypes or plain JS.

The login portal is the first impression: Use the provided vinyl image as a full-cover background with a dark overlay, and place the login card as a glassmorphism or solid black card with a 1px border.
Use JS files for Shadcn components, not TSX.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) ONLY where appropriate (e.g., sticky headers).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like robot, brain, etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Use sonner for toasts. Located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Maintain high contrast hierarchy. Primary action -> Yellow button. Secondary -> Outline border-white/20. Tertiary -> Ghost text-muted.
Provide clear feedback for file uploads (Geral, Editora, Autor CSV/XLSX). Use progress bars or Sonner toasts.
Dashboard charts should summarize total revenue processed vs admin fee collected. Use Recharts with yellow for revenue, white for admin fee.
In the Publisher portal, hide all references to 'taxa admin' as per requirements. Ensure role-based conditional rendering affects UI components directly.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
